reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically sound: a graded Ni-based interlayer can introduce residual compressive stress and refine microstructure, which are well-established mechanisms for impeding dislocation motion and enhancing creep resistance in metallic coatings.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements (creep rate, microhardness, residual stress, SEM/TEM) and a decisive falsification criterion based on statistically significant differences.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful as it proposes a specific, controllable processing intervention (Ni-based transition layer) and links it to a clear mechanism, directly addressing the research question on creep resistance in FCC/BCC HEA coatings.
